description: Rules for persistent harness memory. Control plane: agents cannot change it. harness/memory/store.cjs reads it; validate-memory and the tests check the two agree.

decision.meaning: A decision taken or proposed for the architecture or the harness

proposal.meaning: A suggestion nobody has approved. Never authoritative

assumption.meaning: Something taken as true for now without proof, with an expiry so it is revisited

fact.meaning: An observed, evidenced statement about the system or its environment

constraint.meaning: A hard rule the architecture must satisfy. Pinned in every compact summary

lesson.meaning: What was learned from an episode, and what to do differently

incident.meaning: Something that went wrong, with its impact

test-failure.meaning: A failing test or check, with its cause

resolution.meaning: How an incident or failure was resolved

task-state.meaning: The resumable state of a task: objective, checkpoints, dependencies and the context to reload

ownersNote: Roles. Every agent named in agent-policy.json is also an allowed owner. Personal names are rejected so memory never records a person.

trustMeaning.authoritative: Approved by a human decision that code can verify: an Accepted ADR
trustMeaning.reviewed: Confirmed by a named reviewer who is not the author, or derived by the engine from a hash-chained record
trustMeaning.unreviewed: Written by an agent or person and not yet reviewed
trustMeaning.untrusted: Came from a tool result or a document. Held in quarantine and never returned unless asked for

retrieval.note: Relevance and authority decide the order. Recency is a small tie-breaker and can never lift an entry above a more authoritative, equally relevant one. These weights are working values chosen by this design and confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-28 (T22); they are still not measured.

human.note: A person using the CLI. The type is self-declared by the caller; agents have no shell and cannot write memory files (control-plane path)

importer.note: Derives entries from Accepted ADRs and the hard-constraints table; never invents a statement

engine.note: Derived from the hash-chained run store or evidence records

ttlNote: Working values chosen by this design and confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-28 (T22); not measured. An approved decision or constraint never expires by itself: it can become stale (reviewBy in the past) and a human can supersede or invalidate it.

sensitive.note: Pattern lists are heuristics and cannot prove the absence of sensitive data. The strict field allow-list, the path-class check on file references and the refusal to store free-form payloads do most of the work.

injectionNote: Heuristics for text that reads as an instruction to a model. Added to the tool-output guard's list. They cannot prove a record is free of instructions, and an agent can reword; provenance of agent-written text cannot be proven either (see MEMORY-GOVERNANCE).

neverRecorded: any value that matched a sensitive pattern
